# RaceFeed

> RaceFeed is a free suite of cycling tools for road cyclists, mountain bikers, and triathletes: a unified race calendar plus interactive calculators for gearing, nutrition, and bike fit.

## Tools

- [Cycling Race Calendar](https://racefeed.com.br/calendar.html): Unified calendar of cycling and MTB events and races.
- [Gear Ratio & FTP Calculator](https://racefeed.com.br/gearftp.html): Visualize gear ratios, crank length, gain ratio, and FTP power zones for any terrain.
- [Cycling Nutrition Plan Calculator](https://racefeed.com.br/fuelplan.html): Estimate carbs, hydration, and sodium needs based on ride conditions, with practical fueling strategies.
- [Gear Range Calculator](https://racefeed.com.br/gear-matrix.html): Drivetrain visualizer showing every cassette and chainring combination on a speed/development axis; compare two drivetrains side by side.
- [Stem Comparison Tool](https://racefeed.com.br/stem-comparison.html): Compare bicycle stem dimensions side by side; visualize reach and rise for any stem length and angle.

## Optional

- [Full content (llms-full.txt)](https://racefeed.com.br/llms-full.txt): All tool descriptions and FAQ content inlined in one file.
- [Sitemap](https://racefeed.com.br/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexable pages.
